programme.title: Licence - Informatique des organisations (related; no CS bachelor)
programme.degree: Related only: Licence (grade) Informatique des Organisations, 3 years, entered via the L1 Mathématiques-Informatique (capacity 160); Dauphine-PSL
programme.notes: Université PSL has no bachelor titled Computer Science/Informatique. Related programmes: Dauphine-PSL Informatique des Organisations (business-informatics shape, owner ruling: related), L1 Mathématiques-Informatique (joined shape), and PSL's International Bachelor of Science in AI. The row has no official_domain in kb_top100_list.json; psl.eu (and its subdomain dauphine.psl.eu) is PSL's official site. The core answers below are for the Dauphine L1 Mathématiques-Informatique route.

english.notes: French-taught L1 (2026/2027 page). No English test; no French level threshold was found on the programme page (the Etudes en France/DAP procedure normally sets the French test requirement, not read here).

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published. Prose only: 'Quelle que soit la formation, le recrutement à Dauphine reste très sélectif ... les meilleurs candidats sont retenus d'où qu'ils viennent'; recommended: Mathématiques specialty and the mathématiques expertes option.

deadline.notes: L1 applications go through Parcoursup or, for applicants concerned by the DAP who do not hold a French baccalaureate, Etudes en France; the deadline is set by those national procedures and is not printed on a PSL/Dauphine page that was read. Results of the DAP route come 'dans la deuxième quinzaine d'avril'.

value.population: parents' (or a fiscally independent student's) tax residence outside the EU; 1st and 2nd year Licence Mathématiques-Informatique (MIDO)

tuition.quote: A partir de 200 000 € 2 424 € En cas de résidence fiscale hors d’un état membre de l’UE (pour les parents ou l’étudiant si détaché fiscal) 582 €
tuition.notes: Income-modulated fees ('Tarifs modulés Licence Mathématiques Informatique') for 2026-2027, EUR 0 to 2,424; the non-EU tax-residence line is EUR 582. The page warns rates may change for 2027-2028. Plus CVEC (not quoted).

scholarship_exists.notes: Dauphine L1 FAQ only says 'Différents dispositifs de bourses et d’aide au financement des études sont proposés aux étudiants ... sur critères sociaux et académiques' and points to CROUS (French state social grants). No named Dauphine/PSL scholarship for incoming international bachelor students was read.
